test_case.name: Letter Counting (Strawberry)
test_case.question: How many times does the letter 'r' appear in the word 'strawberry'? Answer with only the digit and no other words or punctuation.
test_case.system_prompt: Reply with only a single digit.

test_case.name: Negative Constraint (Zero 'e's)
test_case.question: Write a complete sentence describing a cat. Do NOT use the letter 'e' anywhere in your response. The letter 'e' or 'E' must not appear at all.
test_case.system_prompt: Strictly avoid the letter 'e'. Any 'e' is a complete failure. You must write an actual, complete sentence describing a cat.

test_case.name: Word Reversal (KNOWLEDGE)
test_case.question: Reverse the letters of the word 'KNOWLEDGE'. Answer with only the reversed word in all-capital letters.
test_case.system_prompt: Reply with only the single capitalized reversed word.

test_case.name: Complex Multi-Fraction Arithmetic
test_case.question: Evaluate the following arithmetic expression to a single final number: \frac{\left(45 \cdot 20 + 120 - 34\right) \cdot \left(72 - 12 \cdot 4\right)}{15 \cdot 4 - 28 + 16} + \frac{144 \cdot \left(85 + 35 - 40\right)}{18 \cdot 4 - 40 + 4} - \left(12 \cdot 8 - 25 + 14\right) \cdot \left(15 - 9 + 1\right)
test_case.system_prompt: Calculate step by step and provide the final integer result.
